text:
rachel (secops): DFIR asked for raw SIEM exports for suspected exfil. Need quick alignment on retention, KMS unwrap, and access controls.

Tariq (eng-sre): My recommendation: provide timeboxed, CMK-encrypted S3 snapshots that are JIT-unwrapped. Default TTL 90d for DFIR exports, with documented exception process. Strip PII by default.

mike (infra): For CMK rotation, use KMS.ReEncrypt to avoid data-plane download where possible. Also enforce kms:EncryptionContext conditions on the role so only archive-purpose decrypts succeed.

rachel (secops): Operational controls: create dfir-temporary role (SSO), max session 12h, require ticket + two approvers (sec + oncall) to unwrap. No long-lived creds. Log every decrypt to CloudTrail -> SIEM.

lena (legal): Legal floor is 90 days in our jurisdictions; exceptions (365/730d) require legal + sec signoff. We also need an access SLA (respond within 48h).

k8s-bot: Policy scan: role/dfir-temporary currently missing kms:EncryptionContext and CloudTrail forwarding requirement.

Tariq (eng-sre): I'll open a PR to add the role, the kms conditions, and a TTL enforcement Lambda. Will also add a console metric 'archive-unwraps' and an alert for >2 unwraps/day per principal.

rachel (secops): Filed SEC-5021 to track policy, PRs, and onboarding checklist. Thanks all.
